design: Final-system reliability and safety evaluation using a fresh 96-case held-out synthetic corpus, eleven configurations, five repetitions for each of eight model-bearing configurations, and one repetition for three deterministic reference conditions.

analysis.pairedBinaryEffect: risk difference with paired 10000-resample bootstrap interval
analysis.multipleComparisons: Holm correction within each outcome family
analysis.zeroFailureRule: Report numerator, denominator, and 95% upper confidence bound.

designation: Only results bound to this freeze, the recorded source commit, and the exact corpus hashes belong to the final primary evidence set.
